definition: LCOE analysis is used across several commercial and regulatory contexts beyond raw long-term price forecasting.
core_idea: Because LCOE captures the full annualized cost of building and running a generating asset, it serves as a comparable benchmark across technologies and as an input to price negotiations and market-clearing estimates.
key_points: Estimating future renewable energy certificate (REC) market prices
Comparing the overall cost-competitiveness of different generating technologies on a like-for-like basis (cost to build and operate over a typical life span and duty cycle)
trading_implications: A trader or structurer can use technology-specific LCOE estimates to sanity-check PPA offers or capacity price bids
